correction_policy.exhaustion: the deterministic claim is published (Explanation.from_candidate + template copy), the veto stays in the trace, a degradation is recorded
correction_policy.feedback: explicit: the veto's reasons are appended to the next attempt's prompt

approaches.pipeline: ExplainerAgent -> ground_claim (GroundingExecutor logic) -> NarratorAgent -> PersonalizerAgent, wired as MatchWorkflow. A vetoed claim goes back to the Explainer with the verdict reasons as feedback.
approaches.single_agent: One chat call returns explanation AND presentation together: {reading, metrics[], cited_event_ids[], title, body}. The reply is checked by the SAME ground_claim; on rejection it is retried with the verdict reasons as feedback, up to the same attempt bound; on exhaustion the deterministic fallback overlay is published.

identical_inputs: deterministic analyst candidates (same feed candidate by candidate_id)
output requirements (Overlay shape: title, body, metrics, cited_event_ids)
correction allowance: max_grounding_attempts = 2 (repo default DEFAULT_MAX_GROUNDING_ATTEMPTS), with explicit feedback (verdict reasons) after each rejection
independent_checks: citation validity: every cited_event_id exists in the event log
metric recomputation: each published metric recomputes from the cited events via touchline.metrics.definitions.compute_metric, same tolerance as grounding
numeric-prose consistency: numbers in title/body/reading are matched against the claimed metric values (heuristic, see methodology)
design.language_rubric: manual; see methodology.md. NOT automated in this harness.

evaluation: touchline-intelligence: multi-agent pipeline vs single agent

faults.incorrect_metric: the first metric value is replaced with a wrong figure (66.0); names, sides and citations are untouched
faults.none: the model-facing client answers from the template engine unedited

persistence.always: every attempt is faulted; the attempt bound is exhausted (tests recovery-through-fallback)
persistence.once: only the first attempt per candidate is faulted; the retry is clean (tests recovery-through-correction)

faults.unknown_citation: cited_event_ids are replaced with ids not present in the event log (ev-unknown-*)

question: Compare the multi-agent pipeline (Explainer -> Grounding -> Narrator -> Personalizer) against ONE agent performing explanation + presentation in a single response, under identical inputs and identical verification.
